questions.text: What is the girl going to do on Saturday?
questions.text_cn: 女孩星期六打算做什么？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'My mum's arranged for us to visit my grandpa that evening.' 解析: 女孩说她的妈妈安排了她们那天晚上去看望爷爷，所以答案是C。

questions.text: What does the boy need to get for his camping trip?
questions.text_cn: 男孩需要为他的露营之旅准备什么？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'Let's replace them. And we'll get you a proper torch.' 解析: 对话中，妈妈说要给男孩换一双靴子和一个手电筒。虽然提到了帐篷，但是决定和朋友share。因此，答案是C（靴子）。
原文: 'Is that your cousin? He looks different from how I remember - I'm sure he didn't have a moustache the last time I saw him.' 解析: 女孩问照片里的是不是男孩的表弟，并且说他看起来和上次见到的时候不一样，因为他上次还没有胡子，对应照片A。

questions.text: Where is the boy's sports bag?
questions.explanation: 原文: 'I put it next to the wardrobe in my room because Dad said it was in the way next to the table in the living room.' 解析: 男孩说他把运动包放在自己房间的衣柜旁边，因为爸爸说它挡住了客厅桌子的路。所以，答案是C。

questions.text: What is the boy going to do at the running event?
questions.text_cn: 男孩在赛跑活动中打算做什么？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'But I'll be waiting at the finish line ready to get some good pictures of the runners.' 解析: 男孩说他因为膝盖受伤不能参加比赛，但是他会在终点线等着，准备拍一些跑步者的照片。所以，答案是A。
原文: 'I'm going to the library tomorrow afternoon to work on that geography project. Do you want to meet there?' 解析: 男孩说他明天下午要去图书馆做地理项目，问女孩是否想在那里见面。虽然女孩提到了咖啡馆，但她不确定是否能去，因此确定答案是B。

questions.text: What is the earliest time today's football match could start?
questions.text_cn: 今天足球比赛最早可能在什么时候开始？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'The original start time was eleven this morning but due to the very bad weather conditions, we're going to see what's happening in the next hour or so, around midday, and make a decision then.' 解析: 女人说原定开始时间是上午11点，但是由于天气原因，他们会在中午左右看看情况再做决定。如果雨停了，他们可以立即开始；如果没停，可能会在一点开始。所以最早是中午12点，答案是B。
